scope: Read-only configuration checks; not full production approval

checks.name: Visible OAuth providers enabled
checks.detail: The release UI offers Google and GitHub.

checks.name: Custom SMTP configured
checks.detail: A production sender and sender address are required; delivery still needs an inbox test.

checks.name: Email capacity configured
checks.detail: Raise the default two-per-hour limit after SMTP setup; size capacity for the pilot.

checks.name: Mobile callback allow-listed
checks.detail: Allow the exact callback registered by both native apps.

checks.name: Production site URL
checks.detail: Set a reachable HTTPS fallback URL controlled by Tack.

checks.name: Server password minimum matches app
checks.detail: The server must enforce the app minimum of eight characters.

checks.name: Leaked-password protection
checks.detail: Enable when available, or document the chosen alternative.

checks.name: Authentication abuse protection
checks.detail: Define and test signup/recovery abuse controls before the public launch.

checks.name: Server password-change reauthentication
checks.detail: Client-only reauthentication can be bypassed by a direct API caller.

checks.name: Password-change security email
checks.detail: Enable and verify the account security notification.

checks.name: Email token expiry bounded
checks.detail: Email verification tokens should expire within an hour.

checks.name: Required Edge Functions active
checks.detail: 12 expected functions active; source parity is a separate check.

checks.name: AI configuration present
checks.detail: Presence only: verify the deployed provider value and successful real-model requests separately.

checks.name: Push server configuration
checks.detail: Required if push is in release scope; mobile registration and APNs also need verification.

checks.name: Bangladesh search source configured
checks.detail: Local sourcing needs a configured provider and a relevance/freshness review.
